title: feat(scaffold): the blank template starts with the Starter app's companies and contacts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgSsAHX9Ukuyz7NLhw4ncpC7)_
Fixes #36945

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 开发者用命令行新建项目后，不再带那个和平台「备忘」重名的示例对象，而是直接带上起步应用的「公司」「联系人」源码，菜单里是公司、联系人和平台自带的任务、备忘。
- 属于「起步应用与平台任务/备忘」专题，让开发者拿到的项目和云端装的起步应用是同一套定义，并有测试防止两边走样。
- 出错只影响此后新建的项目，已有项目不变；新建脚本的改名规则也扩大到了引用处，可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

**The blank template** (`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/`):

- Removed the sample `note` object, its list view and `note.test.ts`.
- Added `src/objects/company.object.ts` and `contact.object.ts`, and `src/views/company.view.ts` and `contact.view.ts`: the definitions of `examples/app-starter` (PR #37399), with `starter_` names spelled `blank_`. Comments are the template's own (what the org-wide default means, field groups, how to remove the objects), so the shipped-comment rationale pins move from `note.object.ts` to `company.object.ts`.
- `src/apps/main.app.ts` keeps its identity (`blank_main_app`, label Main) and its navigation is the Starter's four object entries: companies, contacts, and `sys_task` / `sys_note` with `requiresObject` (the same form as the Starter, until #37404 lands). The Starter's dashboard entry is not carried: the template ships no dashboard, seed data or translations.
- `starter.test.ts` replaces `note.test.ts`: it boots the project with `bootStack` and asserts that a company is refused without a name, that a contact's lookup holds its company, and that `GET /meta/app/NAME` serves the four entries in order.
- README: a "What this project starts with" section replaces "The sample `note` object" (what each file is, that Tasks and Notes are the platform's, how to remove companies and contacts), and the Console, Layout, Verify and Next steps sections follow it. The template's `objectstack.config.ts` / `objectstack.manifest.json` descriptions (dropped at scaffold time) and the registry line say what the project starts with.

**One source of truth: a consistency pin, not a build-time copy** (A2). `src/blank-template-starter-parity.test.ts` parses each template file and the Starter's with the TypeScript compiler and compares the printed definition (the argument of `ObjectSchema.create` / `defineView`, and each navigation entry) with comments removed, after spelling the Starter's `'starter_…'` literals as `'blank_…'`. Formatting and commentary are free; every key and value is held. Its CONTROL case changes one value (`maxLength: 120` to `121`) and requires the comparison to fail. A copy at build time was not chosen: the template under `src/` is what every other test in this package reads and what `npm create` users get, so it has to hold the files itself.

**Scaffolder: every namespaced literal moves, references included** (DEVIATION, declared). `rewriteObjectNamePrefix` used to rewrite `name: 'blank_x'` literals only, so the old template had to reach its object as `Note.name`. Company and contact reference each other (the contact's lookup, the company's related list), so imported references would be circular, and the Starter spells references as literals. The rewrite (and its self-check `findStaleNamespacePrefixes`) now moves every WHOLE quoted literal under the template namespace prefix: `'blank_company'`, `"blank_company"` and the backtick form, wherever it stands. A literal that is not a whole namespaced name is left alone: a platform object (`'sys_task'`), a navigation id (`'nav_blank_tasks'`), a longer string containing the prefix, a literal under another namespace. New tests in `rewrite-identity.test.ts` pin both directions (five reference shapes moved; four non-name shapes untouched, byte for byte). Measured on a real scaffold (`my-app`): every `blank_` literal became `my_app_`, none survived.

**Closing summary.** After "Environment created!", the scaffolder prints "Your project starts with:" (Companies and Contacts in `src/objects/`, Tasks and Notes from the platform in the menu of `src/apps/main.app.ts`), outside the "Next steps:" block that `scaffold-next-steps-pm.test.ts` reads. The parity test holds those lines to the template tree.

**Fence additions, each approved by the zone (o5-P) for this card:**

- `packages/cli/test/create-objectstack-wiring-parity.test.ts`: the views-barrel line it expects is now the two `company` / `contact` lines (the template keeps the generator's default-export barrel shape).
- `packages/cli/test/starter-field-consumers.test.ts`: the control helper (`withoutPlacement`, was `withoutGroup`) un-places a field from every placement the starter wrote: its `group`, a field group's `fields` list (how the Starter places fields), `highlightFields`, and related-list `columns`. See Acceptance notes for why the last one is on every object.
- `packages/cli/test/starter-field-consumers.e2e.test.ts` (nightly): the strip also removes field groups' `fields: [...]` lists, so the blank starter keeps a control.
- `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` + `turbo.json`: `create-objectstack` declares `examples/app-starter/src/**` (with a `heldBy` witness, the walked root) and `examples/app-starter/objectstack.config.ts` (the namespace line), so a Starter-only change re-runs the pin instead of replaying a cached green.
- `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` and `build-with-claude-code.mdx`: the tree, the object code block, the Console callout, the curl examples, the "extend the model" block and the agent prompt describe companies and contacts; the validate transcript reads `3 Objects 18 Fields` and `3 Views` (2 objects and 14 fields measured on a fresh scaffold, plus the guide's ticket).

**Two lines in `packages/platform-objects`, OK'd by the maintainer in the card thread (2026-11-26 08:58Z).** `managed-api-method-affordance-sweep.test.ts:146` and `platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts:82` listed the template's `note.object.ts` as the one scaffolding exemption and pinned it as still existing; they now list `company.object.ts` and `contact.object.ts` (commit 973207ca). Measured: both sweeps 12/12 passed, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` exit 0.

## Tests

- `create-objectstack`: `vitest run`, 26 files, 396 tests passed; `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- New: `blank-template-starter-parity.test.ts` 9 tests; `rewrite-identity.test.ts` +2.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit: `create-objectstack-wiring-parity.test.ts` and `starter-field-consumers.test.ts` green (25 tests).
- A real scaffold (`create-objectstack my-app --skip-install --skip-skills`, resolved against workspace packages): `objectstack validate` passed (`2 Objects 14 Fields`, `1 Apps 2 Views`, no warning), `objectstack lint` all checks passed, `tsc --noEmit` exit 0, `vitest run` 3/3 (`starter.test.ts`).

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

- Starter test: the scaffolded project's notes menu entry deleted, `starter.test.ts` red on the menu case (1 failed, 2 passed); restored, 3/3.
- Parity pin: built-in CONTROL (one value changed in the template's contact object) fails the comparison.
- `starter-field-consumers.test.ts` controls: old helper (`group` key only) on the new template, 12 of 12 blank controls red; the helper with `group` + field-group lists only, 7 red (the highlighted fields); the full helper, green. Old template (`note.object.ts` restored in place) with the new helper: 14/14 green. Helper made a no-op: 14 controls red (12 blank + 2 `os init -t app`).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Root `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` is governed and not edited (A4). It runs `npm test` only (lines 143 to 147 and 568 to 570), never a filename, so the rename is safe; two comments there still name `note.test.ts` (line 139, "The starter's own test (`note.test.ts`)", and line 562, "older than the starter's `note.test.ts`"). They are stale prose for whoever next edits that file.
- The scaffold E2E job installs the generated project from the registry (18.6.0). `sys_task` / `sys_note` do not exist there yet, but the two entries carry `requiresObject`, and `starter.test.ts` reads the served menu and writes no task or note. The job is still red at validate, for the reason in Landing ops §C.
- The field-consumer rule credits a related list's `columns` to the object that DECLARES the list as well as to the listed object: the company's related list of contacts (`phone` column, the contact's field) keeps `company.phone` credited. Measured through the control above: a parent field that nothing displays stays silent when a child's related-list column has the same name, and `withoutPlacement` now strips those columns on every object, which hides it from the control. Carried by #37502 (fix the rule, then narrow the helper).
- `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts` (~294) still cites `note.object.ts` as the starter's authoring style in a comment, and that comment is now partly false: `os g object` places a field with a per-field `group`, while the starter places fields through a group's `fields` list. That and the other stale `note` citations (including `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`) are carried by #37503. `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts` keeps `blank_note` as a census row fixed at its census commit, which is correct.

## Landing ops

### §C Expected reds on this head, what they cost, and what unblocks them

One red is expected on this head; it is not a required context (`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`).

1. **Scaffold E2E · "Scaffold with repo dist"**, step 7 "Validate and build the generated project". Signature: `✗ ObjectSchema.create('e2e_app_company'): unknown key(s) — color.` The job installs the generated project from the registry at `^18.6.0` (also `latest`; main is in changeset pre mode). 18.6.0 rejects three shapes the Starter's source uses: object `color`, `fieldGroups[].fields`, and object-form `relatedLists` entries. Measured against a real registry install: with those three stripped, validate passes, so nothing else in the template is unreleased.
   - **What the red costs.** The job stops at step 7, so steps 8 to 14 are skipped: the template's own `starter.test.ts`, the boot probe, the skills boundary, the pinned shape and both Docker legs. No other CI job runs `starter.test.ts` (this package's vitest excludes `src/templates/`). Until #37441 lands or a 19 prerelease is published, no CI run executes the new template's test or boots a generated project, on this PR or on any later PR that touches `packages/create-objectstack/**` or `docker/**`; a second template regression in that window would be hidden behind the `color` refusal. The job has no push trigger, and the nightly leg runs only the registry canary.
   - **Unblocks when** #37441 lands (scaffold E2E installs packed tarballs of the repo's packages, ruling 7183516548), or a release publishes object `color`, `fieldGroups[].fields` and object-form `relatedLists`. The maintainer asked for this PR to land now (card thread, 2026-11-26 08:58Z).

**Fixed in this PR so it does not go red: `publish-smoke / packed-tarballs`** (contract review 7187700473, M1; the claim amended to add `scripts/publish-smoke.sh`). The smoke's REST CRUD probe read `src/objects/note.object.ts` and wrote `title`; in pack mode the project now comes from the repo-built scaffolder, so the file was gone and the smoke would have stopped at "REST CRUD probes" after the next Release run. The probe now drives whichever starter object the scaffolder wrote: `company.object.ts` with the required `name` (pack mode, and registry mode once the companies template is published), else `note.object.ts` with `title` (registry mode until then), and fails by name when neither exists (commit 1079be70). Measured:
   - registry mode, the whole script: `SMOKE_MODE=registry bash scripts/publish-smoke.sh` exit 0, `Publish smoke passed (registry mode)`, the probe on `smoke_app_note` (`title`): create 201, read 200, update 200, delete 200.
   - the companies branch: the probe section, cut from the script, run against a project scaffolded by the repo-built `create-objectstack` and booted with `objectstack dev --fresh` on the workspace packages (a full pack-mode run needs `pnpm build` of every package, not run here), signed in as the seeded admin: `smoke_app_company` (`name`) create 201, read 200, update 200, delete 200.
   - control: the same harness with the probe section as it was before this commit, against the same project, exits 1 with `ENOENT … src/objects/note.object.ts`.

Cleared at 973207ca: the platform-objects gap (the two sweeps and Cross-package test inputs).

## Verification

Files to read first: `src/rewrite-identity.ts` (the widened literal rule, `namespacedLiteralRe`), `src/blank-template-starter-parity.test.ts`, `src/templates/blank/src/apps/main.app.ts`.

Two-minute check: `cd packages/create-objectstack && pnpm exec vitest run src/blank-template-starter-parity.test.ts src/rewrite-identity.test.ts`, expect every case green, then `npx tsx src/index.ts my-app --skip-install --skip-skills` in a scratch directory and read `my-app/src/apps/main.app.ts`: four entries, `my_app_company`, `my_app_contact`, `sys_task`, `sys_note`.
